- Initial release of dataify-amazon-product-list skill.
- Supports submitting Amazon product list collection jobs via Dataify Builder by keyword and domain.
- Handles API TOKEN resolution, including prompts if missing and instructions for environment variable setup.
- Confirms and displays user-provided parameters in a Markdown table before submitting jobs.
- Includes detailed troubleshooting messages for missing or invalid input fields.
- On success, returns the task_id and directs users to view results at https://dataify.com/dashboard/.
